ja: 私のメール、もう見た？
en: Have you seen my email yet?
alternatives: Did you see my email yet?
Have you looked at my email yet?
point: 「もう」を尋ねるときは yet を文末に

ja: コピー機が速ければいいのに。
en: I wish the copier were faster.
alternatives: If only the copier were faster.
I wish the copier was faster.
point: 現在の願望は wish + 過去形（be は were）

ja: コーヒー当番が誰か、誰も知らない。
en: Nobody knows who's on coffee duty.
alternatives: No one knows who has coffee duty.
Nobody's sure who's on coffee duty.
point: who's on coffee duty は who 節。語順は平叙文

ja: ゴミは分別すべきです。
en: We should sort the trash.
alternatives: Trash should be sorted.
We should separate the trash.
You should sort the trash.
point: 「〜すべき」は should + 動詞の原形

ja: コーヒーを入れたよ。
en: I made some coffee.
alternatives: I brewed some coffee.
I made us some coffee.
point: coffee は数えられない名詞。some を使う

ja: お昼、どこで食べる？
en: Where should we eat lunch?
alternatives: Where do you want to eat?
Where should we go for lunch?
point: 「どこで〜する？」は Where should we〜？

ja: 経理に、領収書がまだだと言われた。
en: Accounting told me my receipts were still missing.
alternatives: Accounting said my receipts were still missing.
Accounting told me they hadn't received my receipts.
point: told me の後は過去形に時制を合わせる

ja: 何があっても、温度設定は触らないで。
en: Under no circumstances should you touch the thermostat.
alternatives: On no account should you touch the thermostat.
Whatever you do, don't touch the thermostat.
point: 否定句が文頭に来ると should you の語順に倒置

ja: もう戻らなきゃ。
en: I must get back.
alternatives: I have to get back.
I've got to get back.
point: しなきゃ は have to / must

ja: 時間がなくて、昼を抜いた。
en: Pressed for time, I skipped lunch.
alternatives: Short on time, I skipped lunch.
Being short on time, I skipped lunch.
point: 理由は Pressed for time で先に言う分詞構文

ja: 仕切り役の人は、今日お休みです。
en: The person running point is out today.
alternatives: The person in charge is out today.
Whoever is running point is off today.
The one running point is off today.
point: 「仕切り役」は run point。person の後ろから修飾

ja: 古いけど、コピー機は動くよ。
en: Although it's old, the copier works.
alternatives: Even though the copier's old, it works.
The copier works, even though it's old.
point: 譲歩は although / even though。but とは重ねない

ja: あの時、部長は帰ってたよ。
en: The boss had already gone home.
alternatives: The boss had left for the day.
The manager had already gone home.
point: その時点より前の出来事は had + 過去分詞

ja: お土産、買わなくてよかったのに。
en: You needn't have bought us souvenirs.
alternatives: You didn't need to buy us souvenirs.
You shouldn't have bought us souvenirs.
point: needn't have + 過去分詞で「不要だったのに」

ja: ホチキスがどこにあるか分かる？
en: Any idea where the stapler is?
alternatives: Do you know where the stapler is?
Know where the stapler is?
point: 間接疑問は where のあとを平叙文の語順に

ja: 置いた充電器、誰が取ったか分かる？
en: Know who took the charger I left?
alternatives: Any idea who took the charger I left?
Anyone know who took the charger I left?
point: who 節の中に、さらに charger I left が入る

ja: 今日は早めに上がろうかな。
en: I might knock off early today.
alternatives: I'm thinking of knocking off early today.
I think I'll head out early today.
point: 「仕事を切り上げる」は knock off

ja: 今日は五時に上がります。
en: I'm leaving at five today.
alternatives: I'm going home at five today.
I'm heading out at five today.
point: 決まった予定は進行形で言える

ja: 噂では、彼女は部長の座を狙ってる。
en: Rumor has it she's gunning for the director's job.
alternatives: I hear she's after the director's job.
The word is she wants the director's job.
Rumor has it she's angling for the director's job.
point: 「噂では」は Rumor has it (that) 〜

ja: プリンターは紙切れだ。
en: The printer's out of paper.
alternatives: The printer has no paper.
The printer's paper has run out.
point: out of paper は紙を使い切った状態。

ja: 新しい椅子が届いた。
en: The new chair arrived.
alternatives: The new chair is here.
The new chair came in.
point: 届いた新しいものには the を付ける

ja: 先週の金曜は休んだよ。
en: I took last Friday off.
alternatives: I was off last Friday.
I took a day off last Friday.
point: 休みを取るは take ~ off

ja: ちょうど君の話をしてた。
en: We were just talking about you.
alternatives: We were just discussing you.
We were just mentioning you.
point: その時していた最中の動作は過去進行形

ja: 朝からずっと報告書を書いてる。
en: I've been writing reports all morning.
alternatives: I've been writing reports since morning.
I've been working on reports all morning.
point: 今も続く動作は have been + -ing

ja: 課長は今日在宅だと言ってたよ。
en: The manager said she's working from home.
alternatives: The manager said she'd be working from home today.
The manager told me she's working from home.
point: said のあとでも、今も続く話は現在形のままでよい

ja: 金曜、お休みをいただきたいです。
en: I was hoping to take Friday off.
alternatives: I was wondering if I could take Friday off.
I was hoping to have Friday off.
point: was hoping で頼みを柔らかくする

ja: プリンター、壊れたと思う。
en: I think the printer's broken.
alternatives: I think the printer has broken down.
I think the printer isn't working.
point: I think の後ろに文をそのまま続ける

ja: 上司に土曜出勤させられた。
en: My boss made me work Saturday.
alternatives: My boss made me come in Saturday.
My boss made me work on Saturday.
point: 強制は make + 人 + 動詞の原形。to は付けない

ja: ケーキが余ってるよ。
en: There's leftover cake.
alternatives: There's some cake left.
We have leftover cake.
point: cake は数えられない名詞。There's でよい

ja: ここでコーヒーと称する物には呆れる。
en: What passes for coffee here beggars belief.
alternatives: I can't believe they call this coffee.
What they call coffee here is a joke.
point: pass for はそれらしく見なされることを皮肉にも使う。

ja: その台車を廊下に戻して。
en: Return that cart to the hallway.
alternatives: Put that cart back in the hallway.
Take that cart back to the hall.
point: return + 物 + to で元の場所に戻す。

ja: 時間があれば手伝うのに。
en: If I had time, I'd help.
alternatives: I'd help if I had time.
If I weren't so busy, I'd help.
point: 現実と違う仮定は if + 過去形、主節は would

ja: このオフィスに要るのは動ける広さだ。
en: What this office needs is elbow room.
alternatives: What this office needs is room to move.
It's space to move that this office needs.
point: elbow room は窮屈でなく動ける空間のこと。

ja: 私は備品共有が好き。
en: I like sharing office supplies.
alternatives: I enjoy sharing workplace supplies.
I like letting others use office supplies.
point: supplies は職場で使う消耗品や備品。

ja: 私が席を外してもいい？
en: May I step away?
alternatives: Could I leave my desk?
Would it be okay to step out?
point: step away は仕事の場所を一時離れる。

ja: 席替えは月曜に発表される。
en: Seat changes will be announced Monday.
alternatives: They'll announce the seat changes Monday.
The seat changes will be announced Monday.
point: will be + 過去分詞で未来の受動態

ja: 遅れそうで、朝礼を逃しました。
en: Running late, I missed the morning huddle.
alternatives: Being late, I missed the morning huddle.
Running behind, I missed the morning huddle.
point: 分詞構文の Running late は「遅れ気味で」

ja: きっと彼、部屋を予約したの忘れてる。
en: I bet he's forgotten he booked the room.
alternatives: I'll bet he forgot he'd booked the room.
He probably forgot that he'd booked the room.
He's probably forgotten he booked the room.
point: 「きっと〜」は I'll bet。節の中に節が続く

ja: 空いてる会議室がないよ。
en: There's no free meeting room.
alternatives: There are no free meeting rooms.
No meeting room is free.
point: 「〜がない」は There's no + 名詞

ja: 上着を持ってくればよかった。
en: I wish I'd brought a jacket.
alternatives: If only I'd brought a jacket.
I should have brought a jacket.
point: 過去の後悔は If only / wish + 過去完了

ja: 総務は私たちを手続きで振り回す。
en: Admin has us jumping through hoops.
alternatives: Admin makes us deal with red tape.
Admin puts us through endless bureaucratic hassle.
point: jump through hoops は厄介な手続きをいくつもこなすこと。

ja: この椅子の方が楽だ。
en: This chair is more comfortable.
alternatives: This chair feels comfier.
This chair feels more comfortable.
point: more comfortable はより座り心地がよい。

ja: 昼食後は私に電話して。
en: Call me when lunch is over.
alternatives: Call me after lunch.
Phone me once lunch is over.
point: 未来の昼食後でも when 節は現在形。

ja: 頼んでくれれば、手伝ったのに。
en: I'd have helped if you'd asked.
alternatives: If you'd asked, I would have helped.
If you had asked me, I'd have helped.
point: 過去の事実に反する仮定は if + 過去完了、would have + 過去分詞

ja: 私、鍵を閉め忘れたかも。
en: I might have forgotten to lock up.
alternatives: I may have forgotten to lock up.
I may have forgotten to lock the door.
point: might have + 過去分詞で「かもしれなかった」

ja: 今なら手伝えるよ。
en: I can help now.
alternatives: I can help right now.
I can help you now.
point: できる は can + 動詞の原形

ja: 昨日休まなきゃ、今ごろ死んでる。
en: If I hadn't rested, I'd be dead.
alternatives: I'd be dead now if I hadn't rested.
If I hadn't rested, I'd be dead by now.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は、had done と would be

ja: 休憩室はどこですか？
en: Where's the break room?
alternatives: Where's the lounge?
Where's the staff room?
point: 場所は Where + is。the を付ける
